name: Naphtali
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Naphtali is a hind let loose: let loose from the Persian captivity when Cyrus, about 538 BC, gave the northern kingdom liberty to stay or to leave.
The goodly words are the peaceable place he went to: Pacific means peace, and the name of the ocean identifies where Naphtali settled.

note.label: The Art of War - Rules of Engagement

points: Naphtali is the so-called Indians of Argentina and Chile today. Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words, and the capital of Argentina carries that mark, for Buenos Aires means good airs, goodly words.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days

points: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali were to stand upon mount Ebal to curse. Half the tribes stood on one side and half on the other, one saying one thing and the other answering.

note.label: Deuteronomy 27: Write the Law upon Stones

points: Naphtali is satisfied with favour and full of the blessing of the Lord: gold, silver, copper, crude oil, forestry the other nations come to Papua New Guinea for, and fishery.

note.label: The Art of War - Rules of Engagement

points: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour: Naphtali is Argentina and Chile today. Satisfied with favour goes into the grapes they are able to produce in their land for wine, and coffee as well.

note.label: Deuteronomy 33: The Blessing of Moses, Identifying the Tribes in the Last Days

points: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities out of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, and the children of Merari had twelve cities out of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun; all given by lot as the Most High commanded by the hand of Moses.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: She calls Barak the son of Abinoam and gives him the commandment of the Most High: draw toward mount Tabor with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun, and I will draw unto thee Sisera with his chariots and his multitude to the river Kishon, and deliver him into thine hand.

note.label: Judges 4: Deborah, Barak, and Jael

points: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field; those tribes are warriors.

note.label: Judges 5: The Song of Deborah and Barak: A Willing People

points: Those tribes are warriors; do not get it twisted. You see how Zebulun and Naphtali, who are in the south Americas right now, get down: that warrior spirit is still in them, only right now it has turned on each other, and the Most High is going to correct it and turn it right again.

note.label: Judges 6: The Call of Gideon: Why Is All This Befallen Us

points: King Solomon sends and fetches Hiram out of Tyre, a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, whose father was a man of Tyre and a worker in brass. He was filled with wisdom, understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass.

Here the mother is named of the tribe of Naphtali, while in Chronicles she is called of the daughters of Dan, meaning she lived in the area of Dan but was of the tribe of Naphtali. The craftsman was of Israel's lineage, sent to do the brass work of the temple.

note.label: 1 Kings 7: Solomon's House and the Brass Work of the Temple

points: In his days Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria comes and takes Ijon, Abel-beth-maachah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee, and all the land of Naphtali, carrying them captive to Assyria.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: The Levites had no land inheritance like the rest of the tribes, so these cities and their suburbs are where they dwelt, given out of Judah, Simeon, Benjamin, Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun and the princes of Naphtali. These are the tribes of Israel, the sons of Jacob whose name was changed to Israel.

note.label: Psalm 68: Let God Arise

points: Zebulun, Naphtali and Galilee of the nations walked in darkness and saw a great light. Unto us a child is born, the mighty God and Prince of Peace, who ends the hatred between the two houses.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: Cornelius the Centurion

points: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun. He lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun. And the land of Naphtali. And the land of Naphtali.
Zebulun and Naphtali were living in Galilee and were called Gentiles.

note.label: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

points: The dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, and afterward more grievously afflicted her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

note.label: Isaiah 9: For Unto Us a Child Is Born

points: From the east side to the west side the portions are given in order: Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, and Judah, each by the border of the one before.

note.label: Ezekiel 48: The Land Divided and the Gates of the Tribes

points: Now you had some Israelites that came back to the land. Watch what they were calling some of the kingdom of Israel: the land of Zabulon and the land of Nephthalim, Galilee of the Gentiles. They were calling them Gentiles.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

points: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

points: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.
What land is this? It said the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali. Galilee of the Gentiles. Who was called Gentiles in this verse? Zebulun and Naphtali. They were called Gentiles here.

note.label: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

points: The scripture calls that country Galilee of the Gentiles. Zebulun and Nephthalim are tribes of the northern kingdom, and this is the key to who the gentiles are that the gospel goes to after the southern kingdom rejects it.

note.label: Matthew 4: The Temptation in the Wilderness and the Calling of the Fishers
